title: Update ServiceNow incident request body
description: JSON request body for the PUT /incidents/{incident_number} resource. Use one operation: update, resolve, or close. caller_id must be the trusted 32-character sys_user.sys_id for the authenticated caller, and the incident number is supplied separately in the URL path. Do not wrap these fields in a request_body property; this schema describes the raw JSON body. The scripted REST resource applies the operation-specific confirmation and state-transition rules.

caller_id.description: Trusted ServiceNow sys_user.sys_id for the authenticated caller. The incident must belong to this caller. Do not generate or infer this value.

operation.description: Operation to perform. Use update to add notes, resolve to move the incident to the configured Resolved state, or close to close an already-resolved incident.

update_note.description: Customer-visible incident comment. Required for operation update unless work_notes is supplied. Do not include credentials, secrets, tokens, passwords, or PINs.
update_note.example: The issue also occurs without the dock.

work_notes.description: Optional internal ServiceNow work note. Required for operation update unless update_note is supplied. Do not include credentials, secrets, tokens, passwords, PINs, or unnecessary personal information.
work_notes.example: Caller reports the issue occurs with a direct cable connection.

caller_confirmed.description: Must be true for operation update, after the caller confirms the requested incident update.

resolution_summary.description: Explanation of how the incident was resolved. Required for operations resolve and close.
resolution_summary.example: Reconnected the monitor cable and confirmed that the display returned.

resolution_code.description: Optional ServiceNow resolution code for operation resolve. Use a value accepted by the target instance.

close_code.description: Required ServiceNow close code for operation close. The incident must already be in the configured Resolved state.

caller_confirmed_resolved.description: Must be true for operations resolve and close, after the caller confirms that the issue is resolved.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-generated retry key, up to 100 characters. X-Idempotency-Key or X-Request-ID headers may be used instead. A matching recorded key returns a duplicate result without applying the operation again.
